reviewer_score.notes: Blind reviewer, Gate 4, run 2027. Valid only with the two caption fixes in g23b-verdict.md applied verbatim (the slides are unaffected). hook 1: there's no number on the cover, the legal headline is long, and this is the page's third Supreme Court story today, so the stake is clear but won't stop a scroll in a second. All other checks strong: the rule plus its conditions and exception (Section 8 / no will / predeceased son's son) are keepable and sendable to families with divided property; the question is own-life; each slide carries its own context. Facts checked against the judgment PDF (paras 1-2, 4, 6-9, 13, 38-42; signed 06.11.2026), LiveLaw and Verdictum. Layout: the cover is clearly the Supreme Court (drum, chhatri, tricolour, mother-and-child sculpture) and is a distinct tight crop, not the full-dome lawn view of the 13:27/15:27 covers. Enlargement 1.07x, sharp. The figures on the steps are tiny and unidentifiable. The sculpture is whole, with its base just meeting the ascenders of line 1 (acceptable). White Title Case headline on the date's left edge; logo and vertical credit readable. Slides 02-04: white labels, one left edge, Sources line clear, no overflow.
